Company Logo
Primary lockup. Use full color, glow intact, only on near-black backgrounds (#07080A or darker). Never recreate the glow effect in flat color.

Logo Clearspace
X
JCODES AI
X = cap-height of the "AI" glyph. Keep a clearspace of at least 1X on every side — free of text, edges and other graphics.

Orbitron carries the wordmark and headlines — always uppercase, wide letter-spacing. Rajdhani handles body copy, labels and interface text.
Iconography Style
Single-weight line icons, rounded joins. One stroke per icon in Signal Red as the accent detail — the rest stays white.
Button Style
Clipped corners echo the logo frame. Primary action in Signal Red with soft glow; secondary stays outlined and quiet.
